page.title: Push notifications
page.intro: Get your notifications on this device even when the app is closed. Notifications never include what people wrote.

server.disabled: Push notifications are turned off on this server.

device.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to turn them on.

hide.label: Hide details on the lock screen
hide.help: Notifications only say that there is new activity, without names or numbers.
